basics.name: Ákos Makra, PhD
basics.label: Test Automation Engineer
basics.summary: Test automation engineer with 4 years of testing experience and a PhD in Information Science. At Magyar Telekom, writes and maintains automated UI, E2E and system regression tests in Python, based on business requirements. Led the effort to fix unstable regression tests on two projects, raising their pass rate from under 65% to over 95%. Previously wrote unit and integration tests for safety-critical dialysis machine software at B. Braun.
basics.metaDescription: Ákos Makra, PhD: Test Automation Engineer. Python, Behave BDD, Playwright and Selenium regression automation at Magyar Telekom.

work.name: Magyar Telekom Nyrt.
work.summary: Writes and maintains automated UI, E2E and system regression tests in Python, based on business requirements.
responsibilities: Maintain and extend the team’s 450+ test regression suite (Python, Behave, Selenium/Playwright) for the customer service agents’ application and its order flows.

Led regular team sessions for 9 months to fix unstable regression tests on two projects. Main causes: faulty test logic (wrong assertions, inconsistent waits, hard-coded data) and test data that was shared or poorly defined for the given process. Fixed the logic and refined the test data. Pass rate went from under 65% to over 95%.
Together with automating 30% of the manual cases, this cut regression on the largest project from 6 testers over 3–4 days to 3 testers in one day.
Refactor test code into clear layers (page objects, step definitions, waits and assertions). Removed several thousand lines of unused code, including dependencies in other repositories.
Set up scheduled GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Investigate failed runs in Kibana/OpenSearch and report results in Zephyr.
Proved with logs that the test environment failed under parallel load and followed up until it was fixed, nearly halving automated test runtime.
Use Claude Code for refactoring and new test cases, with review agents and hooks for code checks.
Mentor manual testers and new colleagues in automation and log-based debugging. Interview test automation candidates.

work.name: B. Braun (via Effective Group Talent Solutions Kft.)
